items.exampleEn: Lawyers often consult each other about difficult problems.
items.exampleZh: 律師們常常互相請教棘手的問題。

items.exampleEn: Good timing is important when you tell a joke.
items.exampleZh: 說笑話時，抓對時機很重要。

items.exampleEn: The building work is under the supervision of an experienced engineer.
items.exampleZh: 這項工程由一位經驗豐富的工程師監督。

items.exampleEn: You can read a transcript of the interview on our website.
items.exampleZh: 你可以在我們的網站上讀到這次訪談的逐字稿。
items.glossZh: 文字紀錄；逐字稿；成績單

items.exampleEn: He got a clerical job at city hall after he graduated.
items.exampleZh: 他畢業後在市政府找到一份文書工作。

items.exampleEn: Please take a handout as you enter the meeting room.
items.exampleZh: 進會議室時請拿一份講義。

items.exampleEn: Conferencing software lets people meet without leaving home.
items.exampleZh: 會議軟體讓人們不用出門就能開會。

items.exampleEn: The city plans to improve sports facilities in every district.
items.exampleZh: 市政府打算改善每一區的運動設施。

items.sentenceEn: The hotel's facilities include a pool, a gym and a small library.
items.sentenceZh: 這家飯店的設施包括游泳池、健身房和一間小圖書室。

items.audioEn: Before you buy a used car, consult someone who knows about engines.
items.audioZh: 買二手車之前，先請教懂引擎的人。
items.questionZh: 買二手車之前應該怎麼做？
options: Ask a car expert for advice
Drive it for a week first

items.sentenceEn: Children under ten may only use the pool under adult supervision.
items.sentenceZh: 十歲以下的孩子只能在大人看管下使用泳池。

items.sentenceEn: The teacher gave us a handout with all the new words from the lesson.
items.sentenceZh: 老師發給我們一份講義，上面有這一課所有的生字。

items.stemEn: We hold weekly meetings with the Tokyo office through video ____.
items.stemZh: 我們每週透過視訊會議和東京辦公室開會。

items.stemEn: She does ____ work, such as typing letters and answering emails.
items.stemZh: 她做的是文書工作，例如打信件和回覆電子郵件。

items.passageEn: Our company recently upgraded its facilities for online meetings. Each meeting room now has a camera and a microphone for video conferencing, so staff who work from home can still join. After every meeting, the system makes a transcript of what people said, and everyone can download the meeting handouts too. The timing of this change was perfect, because many staff stayed home with colds last winter. Some managers were worried about privacy, so new staff must use the system under supervision at first. Workers can consult the technical team when there is a problem, and the clerical staff send the transcripts to clients. A local institution helped pay for the project.
items.passageZh: 我們公司最近升級了線上會議的設施。現在每間會議室都有一台攝影機和一支麥克風可以進行視訊會議，所以在家工作的員工也能參加。每場會議結束後，系統會把大家說的話做成文字紀錄，每個人也都可以下載講義。這次改變的時機剛剛好，因為去年冬天很多員工感冒在家。有些主管擔心隱私問題，所以新進員工一開始必須在有人監督的情況下使用這套系統。員工遇到問題時可以請教技術團隊，文書人員則負責把文字紀錄寄給客戶。地方上的一個機構也出資協助這個計畫。

questions.questionZh: 為什麼說這次改變的時機剛好？
options: 主管一直要求增加線上會議
去年冬天很多人感冒在家
政府今年剛好給公司一筆錢

questions.questionZh: 新進員工使用系統有什麼規定？

items.promptZh: 你提出這個問題的時機不太好。
referenceEn: The timing of your question was not very good.
Your timing for asking this question wasn't great.
rubricZh: 「不太好」可寫，例如 not very good、not great、bad 等
時態配合內容（例如 was、is 等）

items.promptZh: 如果你不確定這個字的意思，可以查字典。
referenceEn: If you are not sure what this word means, you can consult a dictionary.
You can consult a dictionary if you don't know the meaning of this word.
rubricZh: consult 在這裡指「查閱」（例如 consult a dictionary 等）
「不確定意思」可寫，例如 are not sure what it means、don't know the meaning 等
if 子句可放句首或句尾
